name: 63701 · Cpe Girardeau, MO
findings: ZIP 63701 (Cpe Girardeau) has 187 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63701 (Cpe Girardeau) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
